title: plugin-detail README: the RelatedCardStack and record page tiers paragraphs no longer match the count-first related panels
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Found by the #36226 dev (PR #36474) while fixing that PR's README section. Out of its scope. Filed by the seat.

## What happens

Two paragraphs of the plugin-detail README describe a record page the code no longer draws:

- the `RelatedCardStack` paragraph;
- the record page "tiers" text.

Both predate the count-first related panels, so a reader of the shipped README learns a layout that is gone.

## What should happen

Both paragraphs describe the current record page (count-first related panels), or are removed, checked against the plugin-detail source at the time of the fix.

## Notes

Docs only. Dedupe words: plugin-detail README RelatedCardStack, record page tiers README, count-first related panels.
